report_sentences: **Title:** Gravity modulated by a reflectance×temperature interaction, and quadratic drag depending on shape, radius and mass, in a simulated laboratory
The effective gravitational acceleration is g ≈ 9.79 + 0.066·(reflectance−0.5)·(temperature−20) m/s².
This is an interaction effect: reflectance and temperature have no effect on g on their own.
- **Regressions:** I regressed g on all properties, including a reflectance×temperature interaction term.
- The regression gives a reflectance×temperature coefficient of 0.066 (t≈29).
- The main effects of reflectance and temperature alone are not meaningful, because the term is (r−0.5)(T−20) up to centering.
**Discussion:** Motion is projectile motion under an effective g that depends on the product of reflectance and temperature (the combination effect).
irrelevant_property_sentences: Stripes, hardness and batch showed no effect.
- Radius, mass, shape, hardness, stripes and batch have no effect in vacuum.
Hardness, stripes and batch are irrelevant.
